step_ids: Map these literal adapter sets to original UUIDs only at execution; never derive expected sets from product impact output

scenarios.when: same structure, exactly unchanged template definition.source, current verified Case
scenarios.expected: Explicit carry applies; exact MANUAL text/hash/origin and stable IDs/history preserved

scenarios.when: title-only with original current P1 and P3 locks
scenarios.expected: Preserve full unaffected lock objects; no UNLOCK or VERIFY implied

scenarios.when: same structure but actual template source differs
scenarios.expected: Explicit carry only; full original step VERIFY required, prior outputs retained

scenarios.when: template source differs and P3 currently locked
scenarios.expected: Refuse until original explicit UNLOCK, then fresh check/choice/carry

scenarios.when: actual outline changes after prior manual continuation
scenarios.expected: Prior continuation never authorizes changed current source; preserve M, reject stale carry

scenarios.when: EDIT after a new continuation, even if conditions remain present
scenarios.expected: Require fresh explicit source reconciliation; carry must not bypass original adoption guard

scenarios.when: old KEEP_MANUAL or DEFER unresolved
scenarios.expected: Remain pending; no carry upgrade bypass

scenarios.when: registered structural strengthening with a manual note
scenarios.expected: Carry unsupported; both original apply routes must preserve note and reject carrying it

scenarios.when: destructive target or backwards/superseded target
scenarios.expected: Refuse actual legal-shaped request, no business rollback

scenarios.when: current source/baseline unavailable or UNKNOWN
scenarios.expected: No writable carry proof; original complete stale request denied; UNKNOWN precision separately reported

scenarios.when: wrong owner, tenant, park or Case/instance mismatch
scenarios.expected: Current authorization refusal; no private note exposure or business write

scenarios.when: READ/PREPARE/EXECUTE revoked before command or recovery
scenarios.expected: Current authorization precedes replay; denied audit is distinguished from business writes

scenarios.when: source/manual/plan/target versions restore identical visible values
scenarios.expected: Reject stale carry request; clearly label owner-PG fault injections versus legal commands

scenarios.when: same original key exact body and conflicting body
scenarios.expected: Same body replays one original event; conflicting body rejects

scenarios.when: two distinct keys same original preview/CAS
scenarios.expected: At most one commit; no divergent MANUAL carry or duplicate adoption

scenarios.when: actual apply commits and response is deliberately lost
scenarios.expected: Cold original key GET only; no automatic POST; exact proof before releasing pending

scenarios.when: fault immediately after actual PG plan UPDATE
scenarios.expected: Whole transaction rolls back; original note/plan/effective binding/business rows unchanged

scenarios.when: multiple compatible releases after original v1/v2 note history
scenarios.expected: Append proof; original history prefix and immutable consumer binding/stages preserved

scenarios.when: target withdrawn/expired after preview or after commit
scenarios.expected: New apply/VERIFY fail as appropriate; committed historical GET remains truthful under current auth

scenarios.when: unchecked carry, unfinished original command, changed draft, late identity response
scenarios.expected: No phantom handle or automatic command; current denied clears private views, late denied cannot clear newer view

scenarios.when: controlled malformed COMMITTED proof
scenarios.expected: Retain original opaque handle and refuse release/re-POST; injection is not backend response evidence

scenarios.when: original 64 event cap and required VERIFY/UNLOCK reservation
scenarios.expected: Reject before apply if closure cannot finish within original event budget
